headline: 今日影视热搜：《绿灯军团》领跑
headlineEn: Green Lantern Corps Leads Today's Entertainment Buzz
summary: 2026年8月18日，电影市场平静，今日无新片上映，本周共3部新片。热搜由《绿灯军团》《玩具总动员5》《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》《奥德赛》《侠探杰克》占据，IP续作与大片持续引发话题。
summaryEn: On Aug 18, 2026, the film market is calm with no new releases today and 3 new films this week. Trending is led by Green Lantern Corps, Toy Story 5, Spider-Man: Brand New Day, The Odyssey, and Jack Reacher, with IP sequels and blockbusters dominating conversation.
